categories.main_business_segments: Yankuang Energy Group primarily operates in coal mining and sales, coal chemical products production and sales, logistics and transportation, equipment manufacturing, and power generation. The company has diversified into five main industries: mining, high-end chemical new materials, new energy, high-end equipment manufacturing, and smart logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as intelligent mining, deep coal seam digital and efficient mining technologies, and coal indirect liquefaction. It has developed the world's first 8.2-meter ultra-large mining height fully mechanized mining equipment and operates a national-level R&D platform focusing on intelligent coal mining and chemical production technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yankuang Energy serves customers in power generation, metallurgy, chemical industries, and trade sectors. Its coal products are sold domestically across East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northwest China, and internationally to Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, and other countries. Chemical products mainly serve North China, East China, and Northwest China markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with key bases in Shandong, Shaanxi, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, and also has significant operations in Australia. It has overseas subsidiaries and investments in Australia, Canada, Germany, Luxembourg, Hong Kong, and other regions, with global sales covering Asia-Pacific and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yankuang Energy operates primarily upstream and midstream in the coal and chemical industry supply chain, including coal mining, coal chemical production, and equipment manufacturing. It also engages in downstream logistics and trading activities, integrating the full value chain from resource extraction to product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on intelligent and efficient mining, high-end chemical materials, new energy development, high-end equipment manufacturing, and smart logistics. It emphasizes R&D in clean energy, digital mining technologies, and green low-carbon chemical production, supported by multiple national and provincial research platforms and significant patent holdings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of coal, chemical products, and power. Additional income streams include logistics services, equipment manufacturing sales, financing leasing, and investment income from subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yankuang Energy is a leading coal producer and trader in China and Australia, ranking among the top in the industry. It holds a dominant position in domestic thermal coal and is the largest specialized coal producer in Australia. The company leverages its integrated coal chemical industry chain and international presence to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 139.1 billion and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.4 billion. Total assets reached RMB 358.6 billion with a steady growth trajectory despite market challenges. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest heavily in capital expenditures, totaling RMB 17.36 billion in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yankuang Energy emphasizes rich resource reserves, integrated industry chain synergy, strong technological innovation, and internationalized operations. Its unique value lies in intelligent mining capabilities, advanced coal chemical production technologies, and a diversified global footprint, enabling it to provide stable, high-quality energy and chemical products with cost efficiency and environmental responsibility.
